products.name: Heavyweight Boxy Fit Tee
products.description: Crafted from 240 GSM premium carded cotton, this oversized t-shirt features a drop-shoulder design, thick 1.25-inch ribbed collar, and boxy streetwear silhouette.
products.short_description: 240 GSM heavy combed cotton oversized boxy tee.

products.name: Acid Wash Vintage Graphic Tee
products.description: Individually acid-washed for a unique distressed fade. High-density screen print with subtle cracked ink technique on front and back.

products.name: Cyberpunk Anime Drop-Shoulder Tee
products.description: Tokyo streetwear-inspired typographic and manga illustration on 220 GSM super-soft bio-washed cotton fabric.

products.name: Cuban Collar Resort Shirt
products.description: Breathable rayon blend with a relaxed camp collar, box pleat back, and mother-of-pearl buttons. Ideal for warm weather aesthetics.
products.short_description: Relaxed fit camp collar casual shirt.

products.name: Textured Corduroy Overshirt
products.description: Thick 8-wale cotton corduroy with dual chest patch pockets and custom gunmetal snap buttons. Works seamlessly layered over tees.

products.name: Structured Linen Blend Shirt
products.description: 55% Pure French Linen, 45% Cotton blend. Tailored modern relaxed fit with curved hem and breathable weave.
products.short_description: Minimalist pure linen blend summer shirt.

products.name: Baggy 90s Vintage Wash Denim
products.description: Authentic 13.5 oz non-stretch rigid denim in a classic mid-blue stone wash. Wide leg opening with reinforced bar-tack stitching.
products.short_description: Authentic 90s skater loose fit rigid denim.

products.name: Washed Black Carpenter Jeans
products.description: Heavyweight rinsed black denim featuring utility hammer loop, side tool pockets, and triple-needle contrast stitching.

products.name: Street-Style Utility Cargo Joggers
products.description: Relaxed-fit utility cargo trousers engineered with premium water-resistant stretch twill, 6 modular pockets, and adjustable ankle toggles.

products.name: Pleated Relaxed Trousers
products.description: Double front pleats, elasticated back waistband for all-day ease, and clean straight drape in fluid poly-viscose fabric.

products.name: Core Heavy 380 GSM Hoodie
products.description: Double-lined structured hood with clean front pouch pocket, knit from thick 380 GSM brushed fleece cotton for ultimate structure and drape.

products.name: Minimalist French Terry Sweatshirt
products.description: 100% unbrushed French Terry loopback cotton (320 GSM). Clean tonal micro-embroidery at chest with ribbed side gussets.

products.name: Trucker Denim Jacket
products.description: 14 oz washed rigid blue denim trucker jacket with matte silver branded hardware, welt side pockets, and adjustable waist tabs.
products.short_description: Classic heavyweight rigid denim trucker jacket.

products.name: Streetwear Puffer Jacket
products.description: Insulated quilted fill with water-repellent matte nylon shell. Stand collar, heavy two-way zipper, and internal storm cuffs.
products.short_description: Matte finish thermal insulated streetwear puffer.

products.name: Utility Crossbody Sling Bag
products.description: Cordura ballistic nylon construction with waterproof YKK taped zippers, quick-release FIDLOCK magnetic buckle, and modular webbing loops.
products.short_description: Waterproof ballistic nylon tactical sling bag.

products.name: Distressed Vintage Dad Cap
products.description: 100% enzyme-washed cotton twill with distressed brim fraying, low profile 6-panel crown, and antique brass strap adjuster.
